description:
Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Assam in India. 

The scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to families for the education of their children. 

The primary objective of the Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is to promote education among girls. 

The scheme specifically targets families belonging to economically weaker sections. 

The government has set a measurable target of increasing the enrollment of girls in schools by 10 percent annually. 

The scheme provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000. 

This amount is given to families upon the birth of a girl child. 

The assistance is intended to be used for the girl’s education and related expenses. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the dropout rate of girls in schools. 

The government has set a goal to decrease the dropout rate by 5 percent each year. 

Eligibility for the Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is based on specific criteria. 

Families must have an annual income of less than ₹2 lakh. 

The scheme is applicable to families with a girl child born on or after 1st January 2021. 

There are no educational qualifications required for the parents to apply for this scheme. 

The application process for the Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is straightforward. 

Parents or guardians must fill out an application form available at local government offices. 

They can also download the application form from the official Assam government website. 

Required documents include the birth certificate of the girl child. 

Parents must also provide proof of income, such as an income certificate. 

Aadhar card details of the parents and the girl child are also required. 

Once the application is filled out and documents are attached, it must be submitted to the local Block Development Office. 

The application can also be submitted online through the Assam government’s e-District portal. 

The timeline for processing applications is typically within 30 days of submission. 

Disbursement of the financial assistance is made directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The government aims to complete the disbursement within 15 days after the application is approved. 

The implementing authority for the Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is the Department of Social Welfare, Assam. 

Contact details for the department can be found on the official Assam government website. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to empower women in Assam. 

It aligns with the National Policy for Women, which aims to promote gender equality. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for the implementation of this scheme. 

As of October 2023, over 50,000 families have benefited from the Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Parents have reported increased motivation to educate their daughters. 

The financial assistance has eased the burden of educational expenses for many families. 

The government has also initiated awareness campaigns about the scheme. 

These campaigns are conducted in rural and urban areas to reach more families. 

The Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is part of the Assam government’s commitment to improving education. 

It specifically focuses on reducing gender disparities in education. 

The scheme has been recognized as a significant step towards women’s empowerment in the state. 

Monitoring and evaluation of the scheme are conducted regularly. 

The government collects data on enrollment rates and dropout rates. 

This data helps in assessing the impact of the scheme on education in Assam. 

The Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is a crucial initiative in the context of Assam’s socio-economic landscape. 

The state has historically faced challenges related to gender inequality in education. 

By providing financial assistance, the government aims to create a more equitable educational environment. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall development of the state. 

It encourages families to invest in the education of their daughters. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

Regular audits and assessments are conducted to ensure transparency in the disbursement process. 

The Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is a testament to the Assam government’s efforts in fostering a supportive environment for girls’ education. 

The scheme is expected to have long-term positive effects on the socio-economic status of families. 

As more girls complete their education, it is anticipated that the overall literacy rate in Assam will improve. 

The government is also exploring partnerships with NGOs to enhance the reach of the scheme. 

These partnerships aim to provide additional support services to beneficiaries. 

The Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana reflects a comprehensive approach to tackling educational disparities. 

It is a significant move towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals related to education. 

The scheme is an example of how targeted financial assistance can drive social change. 

The government continues to monitor the progress of the scheme closely. 

Future enhancements may include increasing the financial assistance amount based on inflation. 

Overall, the Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana is a critical initiative for the empowerment of girls in Assam. 

It represents a proactive approach to ensuring that every girl child has the opportunity for education. 

The scheme is a vital part of Assam’s strategy to build a more inclusive society. 

In conclusion, the Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana stands as a beacon of hope for many families in Assam. 

It illustrates the government’s commitment to fostering an environment where girls can thrive academically and socially. 

Through this scheme, the Government of Assam aims to pave the way for a brighter future for girls in the state.
